problem: Designers exploring motion treatments for Motif have no fast way to audition a broad library of procedural animation styles, push their parameters, and export the result in the formats and aspect ratios a real deliverable needs. Hand-building each look in code or After Effects takes hours per variation.

users.goal: audition and evolve a treatment for a title, loop or social post
users.context: desktop browser, exploratory session, 10 to 60 minutes
users.pain: each variation is slow to build, compare and export

users.goal: stress-test Motif's style library and parameter model before the engine is built
users.pain: no shared vocabulary of styles and parameters to test against

journeys.name: Audition
steps: Play, scrub and change aspect ratio

journeys.name: Evolve
steps: Mutate with a chosen strength and locked parameters
Open Evolve to breed six variations

journeys.name: Export
steps: Choose format, size, fps and loops
Save MP4, WebM, PNG sequence, PNG frame or preset JSON

scenarios: Designer compares three treatments for a 9:16 social post in ten minutes
Echo exports a seamless 1080p loop and its preset JSON for Motif
constraints: Single self-contained web page, no build server
Every style is a pure function of time so scrubbing, loops and exports are deterministic
Styles loop seamlessly over the loop length
60 fps preview on a mid-range laptop at stage size
fieldSYS-style neutral chrome; the artwork carries the colour
Downloads only through the page's downloads capability

acceptance.criterion: 25 distinct styles across type, geometry, particles/physics and generative categories, each with 4 to 7 style parameters plus shared colour, motion and finish controls
Mutate, Evolve (6 live children), Randomize, Reset, per-parameter lock, and unlimited undo/redo work on every style
Six aspect ratios (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 4:3, 21:9) re-lay out every style without cropping its subject
Frame-accurate export to MP4 and WebM (WebCodecs) with MediaRecorder fallback, PNG sequence ZIP, PNG frame and preset JSON
Every style loops seamlessly: frame 0 equals frame N
Keyboard-complete core journeys, visible focus, reduced-motion start paused, controls labelled
